NeedDef.label: vegetarian satisfaction
NeedDef.description: Rukaya need regular vegetarian food. This bar tracks time since their last vegetarian meal, separately from hunger. It starts full, reaches half after three days, and empties after six days. More than three days without vegetarian food causes -3 mood; six days or longer causes -10. Eating vegetarian food refills the bar and grants +10 mood for one day, refreshing rather than stacking. Meat and meals containing meat provide 60% nutrition and do not refill this bar. Milk, eggs and fungi count as vegetarian food. Drugs and hemogen do not satisfy this need. While lent to another faction for a quest, vegetarian food is provided regularly, resetting this timer without granting the meal mood bonus. After returning, time is counted from the most recent provision.
